newsitem.title: USA: InterMedia buys switches from Telco.
newsitem.headline: InterMedia buys switches from Telco.

text.p: Intermedia Communications Inc said Wednesday it bought five operational Nortel DMS-250 switches and related network infrastructure from Telco Communications Group for about $38 million in cash.
The company said this asset purchase supports its previously announced plan to install 15 local and long distance switches by the end of 1997.
Included in the purchase is network infrastructure connecting 17 markets in the United States.

The company said the deal keeps it on target to achieve positive EBITDA in the second quarter of 1998. It said the about $38 million purchase price is "substantially" included in its 1997 capital expenditure program.
